historical_pattern.summary: MST-wi: replacing the session cookie with an Authorization header must not preserve a privileged body.

entrypoints: HTTP object GET with Cookie vs Authorization

invariant: A privileged body visible with the session cookie must not remain when that cookie is replaced by an Authorization header.

oracle.success_means: Authorization header kept the cookie-privileged secret

severity_rationale: A credential representation change that preserves the body is an authorization break, not a header-parsing curiosity.
